reviews_verbatim.author: Christina Cocuy
reviews_verbatim.text: R&R Woodwork did absolutely beautiful work. The built-ins turned out gorgeous and completely elevated my living room, taking them all the way to the ceiling made such a difference.

reviews_verbatim.author: Aline Rangel
reviews_verbatim.text: Renee did an amazing job! He is attentive, detailed, very fast and efficient, if it weren't for him our project wouldn't have gotten off the ground so quickly.

reviews_verbatim.author: Jessica Golub
reviews_verbatim.text: R&R Woodwork implemented a built in unit for my Kids Den. From start to finish the process and communication was very professional and timely. Renee had many thoughtful details and additions to our initial design.

reviews_verbatim.author: Olivia Ashlyn Rose
reviews_verbatim.text: We are thrilled with our new home office space. Renee and his team did a phenomenal job and worked with our designer to achieve the exact look we were hoping for.

reviews_verbatim.author: Lara Ramos
reviews_verbatim.text: Just perfect: impeccable work, faster then I expected and with great quality. I'm so happy with my chicken coop. It's exactly what I wanted and more.

gallery_curation_notes: 9 unique Google Maps photos downloaded (after a duplicate) and viewed individually. Used: live-edge wood dining table and bench (hero), wood slat doorway/hallway, bedroom built-in with folding doors, dark modern TV wall unit, light oak TV wall unit, floating live-edge shelves over white cabinet. Not used in gallery: a custom chicken coop photo (fun, matches a real review, but kept out of the main 6-tile gallery to keep the gallery focused on interior built-ins; mentioned instead in the services footnote copy) and a close-up of a wood countertop/shelf detail (used as the square logo avatar crop instead).
notes: No Instagram or Facebook found. No public price list, quoted per project. Owner first name 'Renee' confirmed via 2 independent reviews. status: staging.
